findings.finding: Egetis is in an offer period. ANI's recommended SEK 11.25 cash bid is backed by 42.2% irrevocables and a no-increase statement, so the stock is pinned about 1.0% under the offer, with a small one-session upside tail if a competing bid appears and almost no downside tail inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior offer period for this name. On 2026-11-05 the stock closed 11.14 (high 11.16, low 11.06) against 9.99 the day before, i.e. it repriced to the bid in one session and then traded in a range of about 1% (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/EGTX.ST?range=10d&interval=1d).
findings.original_quote: ANI kommer inte att höja priset i Erbjudandet, förutsatt dock att detta uttalande inte ska gälla om ett konkurrerande erbjudande offentliggörs. (ANI will not increase the price in the Offer, provided, however, that this statement shall not apply if a competing offer is announced.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The roughly 1.0% gap between the 11.14 spot and the 11.25 offer is the market's price for the conditions (90% acceptance, competition and FDI approvals) and for about seven weeks to settlement around 29 Dec. If the market expected a competing bid, the stock would trade above 11.25; if it feared a deal break, the spread would be far wider than 1%. Neither is the case, so this finding is sized at 0.
findings.independence: The English board statement says the same (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b155f6f007fe4aef95600f54e1bedcd81&lang=en&src=listed); it is the same document in the other language, so it is not independent.

outside_window.finding: Offer acceptance period about 2026-11-20 to 2026-12-18, settlement about 2026-12-29. A competing bid could arrive any time before then, and the irrevocables lapse only for an unmatched offer more than 5% higher

baseline_tension: The baseline's lean (-0.655, from the run-up term) and its 6.06% move proxy both assume a print still to come. Neither applies: the print is out, and the 13.1% 20-day run-up is mostly the bid premium arriving on 2026-11-05, which pins the stock rather than leaving it room to mean-revert.
language_note: The Swedish sources carried nothing the English ones did not. The board statement, the Q3 report and the PRV release were all published bilingually at the same timestamp on the Nasdaq Nordic feed, and the Swedish quote above is a translation of the English text, not extra information.
MFN's Swedish calendar ('Kvartalsrapport 2026-Q3, 2026-11-06 07:00') confirms the original date, which explains why the vendor row was stale; it adds no price information.
lessons_applied: 'In a live bid, results are noise ... the offer is the finding': this moved the offer from already_public alone into findings as an explicit 0.0-sized item, so the set says why the name is pinned. impact_sum, abs_move_pct and p_up are unchanged.
